result.draft_reply: Sorry for the delay, and thanks for your patience. There isn’t a dedicated Dark option yet; the available themes are Light and System Default, and the theme setting is available on all plans. The macOS desktop app v4.1 has a known issue where System Default does not switch to dark mode. As a workaround, please use the web app in your browser; a fix is planned for desktop app v4.2. Scheduling a theme change in the app isn’t supported yet, but System Default can follow your operating system’s automatic appearance setting. The web app is not affected by the v4.1 desktop issue. I’ll also pass along your feedback about a dedicated Dark option and scheduled switching.
